acribi_page.description: Page on acribi.com where the calculation is used.

value.description: Number, array, object, string or boolean. null stands for an absent limit or an infinite number of degrees of freedom.

unit.description: "1" for dimensionless quantities; "text" or "boolean" for non-numeric options.

expected.description: At least one of value (with tolerance), atMost or equals.

value.description: Value as published by the source.

tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance, in the same unit as value.

atMost.description: Upper bound, when the source states a bound rather than a value.

published.description: The value as printed in the source.

recomputed.description: Higher-precision value recomputed by Acribi from the published inputs. Not a published value.

location.description: Section, example, table or page in the source.

kind.description: official: standards body, metrology institute, accreditation body or government agency. secondary: journal, conference paper, manufacturer or software vendor.

operation.description: Name of the operation in runner/operations.mjs.
